description:
Run ONCE at conversation start. Loads behavioral prefs + recent context.

Previews carry a 'complete' flag: true = full content shown; false = opening only, memory_retrieve(id) for the rest.
After init, use memory_search for specific queries.
Shared collections -> 'collections' field. Pending teammate signals -> 'signals' field: retrieve the memory_id, act on it, then signal(ack, signal_ids=[...]). Ack closes a signal and deletes nothing; ack anything no future session of yours owes an action, including a receipt or an FYI. Leave one open only when work is still owed, and say by whom. Pending collection invites -> 'pending_invites' field ([{slug, display_name}]): tell the user they've been invited and offer collection_manage accept/decline.
Write routing: after any memory_add/edit/consolidate, the response namespace shows where it landed (your agent name, or "col:<slug>"). Verify it matches the collection you intended.

machine_id.description: Machine id for workspace paths (run hostname). e.g. p620. Omit if no filesystem.

query.description: Optional turn-one search (piggybacks on init). Top 3 auto-expanded if score >= 80.

name: init_core_memories
